title: SWING ARM
description: Round 2 benchmark record. UK-garage skip, electro call-and-response, industrial steel, futuristic vowel bass and cinematic tension from one "talking steel" sound family.

tracks.description: Talking-steel hook voice (G4 source, rate-performed). Calls in bars 1-8, dives in the payoff.
From the payoff on: the voice an octave higher on the opposite side, diving with the answer.
The same voice, tape-stopped into a groan at the bar-9 stall; drenched in room.
Vowel bass from the same steel recipe at G2: takes over the call in the payoff.
G1 sine sub with 808 drop. Answers the call with octave dives; doubles the bass call in the payoff.
Orbital Foundry mechanical kick, retuned toward D (the fifth).
Industrial snare + chrome clap on 2 and 4.
Swung machine ticks and pixel hats: the garage shuffle.
Steel open hat on the offbeat eighths (same steel family).
Metallic strike tuned to D6: the third voice in the call and response.
Low boom tuned to G for the stall and the payoff downbeat.
Bowed-steel halo: G5 against A-flat tension, resolving to G5+D6 in the payoff.
